amends: nba-multimarket-research-1.2 (adds official injury-report availability); RUN071 sealed and untouched

sources.injury_reports: apps/nba/.local/normalized/nba_complete_injury_final_20261006/reports.jsonl.gz (816 official NBA injury-report PDFs, retrospective receipt)
sources.tipoff_times: api-sports games_2022..2024 by (Eastern date, home, away) joined to NBA game ids; 2025-26 from the tipoff carried by the report rows themselves

point_in_time_rule: a status counts only if its report timestamp is at least 60 minutes before tipoff; the latest such report per game/player wins; games without a known tipoff contribute no availability information (treated as unobserved, not as available)
play_probability: Beta(1,1) smoothed participation rate per status over the training window, refit per target season
trailing_player_value: mean minutes and points of the last 20 participated games within 370 days, strictly before the game date

team_features.expected_missing_minutes: sum over listed players of trailing_minutes * (1 - play_probability)
team_features.expected_missing_points: sum over listed players of trailing_points * (1 - play_probability)

winner_model: v1.2 logistic plus [missing_points_home/10, missing_points_away/10], ridge prior 0 on the new weights
player_model: per market logistic on [logit(v1.2 probability), own_questionable_or_doubtful, own_probable, teammates_expected_missing_minutes/48] fitted on the training window, ridge toward [1,0,0,0]
availability_evaluation: log loss of participation: status table vs trailing base rate, for rows listed in the boxscore; test seasons only
references: v1.2 (this protocol's predecessor) on identical rows
promotion: none; retrospective; injury-report receipt time is not proof of original availability
not_modeled: bookmaker prices and CLV (no historical NBA game odds locally; The Odds API credits reserved for football until the 2026-11-01 reset)
late scratches after the last pre-T60 report
